Ending at 212.9 lbs against a 200 lb target, you're 12.9 lbs out with 8.8 lbs of the cycle's progress banked -- short of the target, but the trend in the second half was clean once protein came up to the 224g minimum and stayed there.

Waist measurements kept trending down even during the weeks the scale didn't move, which is the clearest sign the plateau was water/adaptation rather than a genuine stall in fat loss.

This cycle didn't run too long -- the plateau resolved with time and a planned refeed rather than needing an extension, and the final two weeks at increased steps closed most of the remaining gap.
